subject: Re: Insight Salon — guest onboarding, NDAs & venue contract
messages:
From: Angela Morris <amorris@primepartnerships.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private evening briefing for Horizon execs — NDA & guest curation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for agreeing to explore a private briefing for three of our Horizon execs while they're in town the week of May 20. We discussed a short (90 minute) dinner/salon focused on inference operational best practices — tight invite list (6–8 guests) and zero press.

Two items I need from Redwood to move internally:
- Confirmation of your NDA process (we often require a short data handling addendum)
- A draft guest list template and dietary/allergy capture so we can start approvals

Tentative dates: May 20 or May 21 evening. Can L'Atelier or a similar private chef's table work? Budget guidance would be helpful — Horizon typically expects a per-guest all-in figure.

I'll loop Samir (Horizon) on logistics once we have a draft.

Best,
Angela Morris
Director, Partnerships
Prime Partnerships

Attachments: none

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Angela Morris <amorris@primepartnerships.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private evening briefing for Horizon execs — NDA & guest curation

Hi Angela — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run point.

Quick answers and next steps:
1) NDA/process: We have an executive NDA + optional privacy addendum for event-specific data handling. I'll attach the standard NDA and the privacy addendum draft. If Horizon's legal needs changes, we can redline.
2) Guest template: attached a lightweight guest_list_master.xlsx that includes columns for name, title, company, affiliation, dietary restrictions, mobility notes, and intro topic.
3) Venue: L'Atelier's chef's table is perfect for a quiet, off-the-record conversation. I've spoken with their events lead; they can accommodate 6–8 on May 20/21. Their initial proposal is attached.
4) Budget: ballpark all-in (venue, chef's tasting dinner, tax & service) is $350–450/guest depending on menu and wine pairings. If Redwood underwrites or sponsors part of the cost, we can present a combined sponsorship line to Horizon.

Proposed immediate asks for your side:
- Please confirm which of May 20 or 21 is preferred (Horizon availability).
- Can you share Samir's contact? If you're comfortable, I'll loop him and send the NDA + DocuSign request.

I'll loop Ben Carter from Events for a quick cost estimate and sponsorship line.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head, Field Events & Roundtables
Redwood Inference

Attachments: LAtelier_venue_proposal_20270501.pdf, guest_list_master.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private evening briefing for Horizon execs — initial guest seed

Jonas / Ben — forwarding Angela's note and the guest template. I've started a seeded list (see attached) with 8 prospective guests across fintech / infra / platform buyers who would add value and are likely to accept. Highlights: 3 VPs, 2 Heads of ML, 3 CTO-level + a small quota of legal/comms attendees (kept to one).

Ben, can you please: 1) give a quick sponsorship suggestion (Redwood covers up to $1,500 and Horizon covers remainder?) and 2) confirm L'Atelier provisional hold for May 20/21 and whether we need a deposit.

Also, small ask — can we add a one-line confidentiality note on the invite that guests must agree to? We should avoid overly formal NDAs for guests but include an expectation of off-the-record conversation.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: guest_list_master.xlsx (updated)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizontech.ai>
To: Angela Morris <amorris@primepartnerships.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private evening briefing for Horizon execs — NDA & guest curation

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 2:07 PM Angela Morris <amorris@primepartnerships.com> wrote:
> Jonas — looping Samir from Horizon as requested.

Thanks, Angela and Jonas. Happy to proceed. A couple of items from our side: we will route event-level NDAs through our procurement team; however, we do require a short privacy/addendum clarifying that any offline notes referencing customer data are not considered production data and will be retained for 30 days only.

Also, if Redwood is proposing sponsorship coverage, please confirm whether any presentation materials will include product screenshots or customer anecdotes — we ask that customer names not be displayed without permission.

For procurement: connect with me and I will introduce HZ procurement (procure@horizontech.ai). For quick planning, May 20 is preferred.

Thanks — Samir
VP, Product & Partnerships
Horizon Technologies

Quoted-forwards and signatures preserved.

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Angela Morris <amorris@primepartnerships.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizontech.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-05T22:43:00-07:00
Subject: Final — DocuSign + playbook & next steps (May 20)

Thanks, everyone — great alignment. Final plan below.

Summary / next steps:
- Date confirmed: May 20 evening, private chef's table at L'Atelier (off-the-record).
- Guest list: Laura's seeded list accepted; Angela will provide final names by EOD May 10. Please use the attached guest_list_master.xlsx for any edits.
- NDA & privacy addendum: Attached executive_ndas.zip contains the standard NDA + the privacy addendum. I've created a combined DocuSign envelope for Redwood + Horizon signatories: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-sign-event. Please sign by COB May 12 so L'Atelier can finalize staffing.
- Cost & sponsorship: Ben, attached redwood_event_cost_estimate.xlsx outlines two options: Redwood partial sponsorship (Redwood covers $1,400; Horizon covers remainder) or Redwood full-cover option (internal approval required). Ben — can you confirm which we should present by May 7?
- Procurement contact: Samir, please introduce procure@horizontech.ai; I'll route the DocuSign + invoice instructions to them.
- Invite language: We'll include a single sentence in the invite: "This event is off-the-record; please do not share attendees' remarks publicly." Not a legal NDA for guests, but a mutual expectation.

Attachments: executive_ndas.zip, guest_list_master.xlsx (final version), redwood_event_cost_estimate.xlsx, LAtelier_venue_proposal_20270501.pdf

If there are no redlines to the NDA by May 9 we'll proceed with DocuSign. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Jonas
Head, Field Events & Roundtables
Redwood Inference
